gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve the details of a specific task by its ID to review its current status and assigned resources.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON object containing the task details, including its title, description, status, assignee, and any comments.

gold.user: As a team member, I need to cancel a task that is no longer relevant to our project, so that it is marked appropriately in the system.
gold.ideal: The API should return a success message confirming that the task has been canceled, along with the updated status of the task.
